lines.reason_short: Dented right front door needs a new shell.
lines.reason_long: The right front door shell fits all trims. It is expensive and not returnable, so please confirm.

lines.reason_short: Door moulding usually comes off with the shell.
lines.reason_long: The right front door moulding is normally replaced when the door shell is swapped. It depends on the door shell being confirmed.

lines.reason_short: Outer handle may need replacing with the door.
lines.reason_long: The right front outer door handle often has to be moved or replaced when the shell is changed. It depends on the door shell being confirmed.

lines.reason_short: Check the right mirror and blind-spot sensor.
lines.reason_long: This Akera has a heated blind-spot mirror on the door. If it is removed, check the sensor works after refitting.

result.reply: I suggested a right front door shell, plus moulding and handle to go with it.
